body:
At about 5:00 I took 3 ephedra pills (mini-thins) as I was leaving work.  I didn't really notice the effects of the pills much, and when I got home I ate a medium sized weed brownie from a strong batch my roommate cooked up.  I began to feel the high from the brownie about an hour later, as I had the day before, and noticed nothing abnormal about the high.
I got up to go to the bathroom, and while I was taking a piss, I started to feel very lightheaded.  I grabbed the towel rack to steady myself, and zipped up my pants.  I stood there for a second, and then I began to fall.  I wasn't quite blacked out, as I remember struggling around during my fall, though my vision did go in and out on my way to the ground.  I regained full control of my faculties while I was laying on the ground.  I headed back for the living room to sit down, where everything felt fine again.  I still had to go to the bathroom, so I attempted to go again.  Again, while I was in the bathroom I began to feel very woozy.  I lay down on the bathroom floor for a little while, and then I was finally able to urinate, albeit a bit unsteadily.
I'm a fairly experienced drug user, and I have never passed out like that, unless I was under the influence of god-awful amounts of liquor.  I had already eaten the weed brownies the day before with no ill effects, so I assume it was the ephedra that took me down.  I think I am done taking mini-thins recreationally.  That was a fad I missed as a kid, and now that I have begun using them, I am glad I missed it.
